patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section with content scrolling over a fixed background image/video, followed by distinct, full-width content sections with generous vertical spacing.
Section headings use an extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif font, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
A stark monochromatic palette of black, white, and light grey dominates, with minimal and subtle use of accent colors primarily within product imagery or small graphic elements.

The initial hero section features a large product image/video that remains fixed in the background while subsequent page content scrolls smoothly over it. The main navigation (logo and CTA) remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
Content is organized into clearly defined, full-width sections, often using alternating light grey and white backgrounds to delineate them, enhancing readability and visual flow.

technique_notes: The hero section is built with a large, full-viewport background video or image that is fixed in position, allowing all subsequent page content to scroll on top of it. This creates a layered, immersive effect.
The primary navigation elements (logo and 'Buy Now' button) are implemented as a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling.

Typography is managed with a clear scale: very large, bold, uppercase sans-serif for main headings, smaller uppercase sans-serif for sub-labels, and a lighter weight sans-serif for body text, ensuring strong contrast and readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, light-weight sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical padding between sections and ample negative space around elements, especially in the hero.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, minimalist aesthetic, particularly the use of an extremely large, fixed hero product image/video that content scrolls over, creating a dramatic and immersive introduction. The unique product (an hourglass-inspired watch) is perfectly complemented by the stark, high-contrast black and white palette and monumental typography, making the product itself the undeniable focal point.
